scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by a direct proof and finite independent code tests; existing additive and elementary dihedral results are credited. No external independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite odd-order abelian rotation kernels; no even-order extension, no all-type reconstruction claim, and historical priority may have unlocated equivalent formulations. Finite checking is corroborative, not a proof.
title: Affine-retraction compatibility over odd generalized dihedral groups and recovery of hidden exponents
